**Security: pass-with-notes** at `1396154725e43fc142c529825408084558b269e3`.

S136001 is closed for current route guidance and all 16 latest templates. The repair delta `560e260..1396154` was reviewed, including all 22 template versions. No new reportable security vulnerability.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No new reportable vulnerability | N/A |

Complete dynamic arguments in the route are single-quoted, including composite addresses, field/value arguments, paths and report text (`skills/pij/references/routes/community.md:17-30,55-79`). Retaining the surrounding quotes and replacing each embedded apostrophe with `'\''` correctly preserves one literal POSIX argument. Bodies use `--body-file`. This is a verified source contract, not observed exploit or automatic-interpolation proof.

The ten optional v1 templates and six current core v2 templates contain repaired recipes. Six historical core v1s remain byte-unchanged and unquoted, as explicitly required for shipped-version immutability; they are still selectable by explicit version, and existing role copies are not migrated. Thus **all 22 were inspected, not all 22 were changed or quoted**. This retained legacy-version risk is the reason for notes.

Core v2 changes are quoting/fill instructions, version metadata and changelog; default catalog selection and README references select v2. All 22 embedded-version SHA-256 pins matched source-file digests (`crates/daemon/src/community/templates.rs:60-86,136-155,675-808`). The HTTP latest-version expectation is updated (`crates/daemon/tests/templates_http/mod.rs:80-97`).

The guard checks selected-leaf help, exact flags, applicable Usage-required flags, single-quoted placeholders and numeric-latest template selection (`crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs:256-488`). All eight single-fault controls were source-checked: unknown verb, unknown flag, flag prefix, wrong-leaf flag, two missing-required-flag cases, unquoted placeholder and double-quoted placeholder. These are command-contract guards, not a general shell parser.

Second-run canary evidence reports a fresh Copilot prime, seven privately created roles, refusal from inherited identity variables followed by cleanup, and teardown. The wrapper pins private address/state. No second-run live-daemon writes are alleged. This is recorded canary evidence, not an exact-head attestation or arbitrary-value quoting exercise. The first run's stray read-only live-daemon refusal remains documented (`docs/plans/204-community-route/assets/evidence/canary.md:50-69`; `assets/evidence/canary-rig.sh:22,54-78`).

The 31-file repair/template privacy scan found no credential/token literals or private foreign identities/paths. The prior C21 own-pij-layout concern remains withdrawn.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42384881901](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42384881901), attempt 1, passed all four jobs; JUnit lists 2,088 passing cases, including the command-fault, current-command and immutable-version guards. Source/CI review only, no local builds/tests, exploits, credential reads, live operations or product edits. Other prior scoped dispositions stand.
